owner_surface: prospect_def_value.POS_ADJ (the one ladder in the codebase)
question: Replace the unsourced folklore positional-adjustment table with the ladder recovered from Baseball-Reference's own runs_position?

fit.method: SVD least squares, no intercept: runs_position*650/PA ~ sum_pos (innings share) * ladder[pos]
fit.solver_note: the prior recon table used Gaussian elimination on the normal equations, which on this ill-conditioned share matrix loses accuracy: R2 0.9817 vs 0.9821 for SVD, coefficients off by up to 0.35 runs (C). The SVD solution ships.

dh_specification.issue: DH carries no fielding innings, so its exposure must be imputed, and the imputation moves EVERY rung (the shares renormalise). Two live specs existed in the tree and disagreed by up to 0.35 runs on C, 7x the sampling CI.
dh_specification.spec_shipped: DH exposure = (StatsAPI DH games) x 8.5 innings
dh_specification.spec_alternative: DH exposure = residual, max(0, PA x inn_per_pa - fielded innings), inn_per_pa = 1.9799 (median over >= 400 PA seasons). This is what positional_fit.py uses and it reproduces exactly: C 10.56, SS 8.89, 2B 4.65, CF 3.63, 3B 3.28, LF -6.47, RF -6.45, 1B -8.60, DH -13.76.

head_to_head.protocol: same 9,101 rows, same y, same solver; only the DH column differs. 4-era OOS MAE.
head_to_head.verdict: shipped spec CLEARS, but by only 0.037 runs/650PA
head_to_head.caveat: the win is NOT uniform across eras: the residual spec is better on 2019-2026 (OOS MAE 0.969 vs 1.043), the universal-DH era. If the DH rung is ever load bearing for a modern-day read, refit on the residual spec and re-gate.

identification.note: every row of innings shares sums to 1, so adding a constant to all nine slots is unidentified: the LEVEL of a positional-adjustment table is a convention, not an estimable quantity. Only the SHAPE is gated.
identification.invalid_null_rejected: a permutation null that shuffles y is INVALID here -- on random labels a refit 9-parameter model trivially beats any fixed non-zero vector, so that null (p95 2.534) sits ABOVE the observed effect by construction. A parametric null that resamples UNCENTERED folklore residuals is also invalid (it re-injects the level error as bias: p95 ~1.45 runs for all nine slots identically, the signature of a contaminated null).

gate_shape.verdict: all 9 slots CLEAR their H0 band; C 31.4x, 1B 22.9x, DH 11.6x, SS smallest at 1.8x

gate_accuracy_4splits.protocol: fit on the other three eras, score the held-out era; eras 2000-2006 / 2007-2012 / 2013-2018 / 2019-2026
gate_accuracy_4splits.baseline: folklore + c* (level-corrected, so the claim is shape-only)
gate_accuracy_4splits.verdict: CLEARS. Control at -5.02 runs confirms the protocol discriminates.
